name: ca77y-engineering
description: Idea-to-shipped development pipeline: the analyst skill (shapes stories, records cards), the lead skill (run in the main session, takes one task end to end — no splitting), the board skill (helps a project write or repair the BOARD.md declaration the pipeline reads directly, at a fixed path, on every run), the forge skill (the same, for the FORGE.md declaration that says how the project branches, commits, and ships — without which the lead stops before it creates a workspace), junior-coder and senior-coder (the two build tiers, routed on the coding complexity score the spec carries), qa (validation plus the local code review), writer (specs + docs), auditor. Research and the Markdown research library live in the companion ca77y-library plugin, used when installed. Root manifest mirrors .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
